-- Phase 1: spec only. Bodies are left as `unreachable`.
-- The ex lines assume notes/missing.txt and notes/secret.txt do not exist.
-- Under fs.sub("notes"), the plugin's "notes/../secret.txt" resolves to
-- notes/secret.txt, which is inside the sandbox.

plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs =
  post out.char_count() >= 1
  ex plugin("missing.txt") == "|"
  let mine = fs.read(path) else ""
  let theirs = fs.read("notes/../secret.txt") else ""
  mine + "|" + theirs

run_plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs =
  pre path.char_count() > 0
  post out.char_count() >= 1
  ex run_plugin("missing.txt") == "|"
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    return plugin(path)

test_run_plugin_outside() uses fs =
  assert run_plugin("../secret.txt") == "|"
